props.kicker: Open source · runs on your machine
props.title: Nightshift
props.subtitle: GitHub issues in, merged pull requests out

scenes.narration: Nightshift is an autonomous coding loop. It turns GitHub issues into merged pull requests, on your own machine, with Claude Code.

props.headline: A daemon over your issue queue

scenes.narration: A local daemon polls your issues, builds a dependency graph, and runs each ready issue in its own git worktree.

props.headline: A strict template

props.title: issue #41
props.code:
## Size
M
## Contract
Owns: retryUpload
Uses: UploadError
## Acceptance
- 3 retries, then UploadError
## Touches
- src/upload.ts

props.footer: Linted before a single token is spent

scenes.narration: Every issue has a size, a contract of what it owns and what it uses, acceptance criteria, and the files it touches. A linter rejects incomplete issues before any tokens are spent.

props.headline: Critical path first
props.footer: Two issues never edit the same files at once

scenes.narration: The files an issue touches work as a lock, so two issues never edit the same file at once. A worker pool fills each free slot with the issue that unblocks the most work.
Size picks the workflow and the model. Small issues go straight to Sonnet. Medium ones write a plan first. Large ones fan out to one subagent per subtask.

props.headline: The agent reports in JSON
props.footer: No git, no labels: the harness does that

scenes.narration: The agent never touches git or labels. It ends by writing a short JSON report: done, a question, or a request for more files. A question is posted on the issue, and your answer resumes the same session.

Every change must pass your check command, then a scan for broken encoding and leftover conflict markers. Then a reviewer reads the diff, the issue and the plan. Blocking findings must cite a file and a line.
At ship time, edits outside the declared files are caught. Conflicts go down a ladder: union merge for registry files, regenerated lockfiles, and an agent only for what is left.

props.headline: Merges itself, unless you say review
props.footer: Its own open PRs are rebased when main moves

scenes.narration: The pull request merges itself, unless the issue has the review label. And when main moves, Nightshift rebases its own open pull requests.

props.headline: It waits, then resumes
props.footer: Reset time read from the session transcript

scenes.narration: Hit your usage limit overnight? It reads the exact reset time from the session transcript, pauses, then resumes the same session. Nothing is marked as failed.

props.headline: Built to be supervised
props.footer: nsh status shows every issue in flight

scenes.narration: nsh status shows every issue in flight. nsh wait blocks until something needs you, so a supervising agent can follow along without reading logs.

props.label: issues of the renderer behind this video, built by Nightshift

scenes.narration: Nightshift built the tool that rendered this video, across about forty-five issues.

props.headline: Two commands

lines.text: check: npm run check · install: npm ci

props.footer: Needs Claude Code and the gh CLI

scenes.narration: To start, nsh init registers a repo and detects its check and install commands. Then start the daemon and file your issues.
